traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and technical requirements for story 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG are implemented and verified. The plugin exposes recommended and strict flat-config presets, tested via FlatESLint to ensure they enable traceability rules when spread after a plugins registration object (REQ-CONFIG-PRESETS, REQ-FLAT-CONFIG, REQ-PROJECT-INTEGRATION). Rule schemas for configuration options are defined with JSON Schema-style constraints (including additionalProperties: false) and are tested to confirm ESLint emits clear errors for unknown options and invalid types (REQ-RULE-OPTIONS, REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION). Story path customization and project-boundary behavior are implemented in valid-story-reference with options for storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, and requireStoryExtension, and are thoroughly tested (REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS). Documentation in user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md and README.md provides clear configuration examples for JS, TS, mixed, and monorepo projects, as well as troubleshooting guidance, satisfying the User Experience and Documentation acceptance criteria. The full Jest suite, including all config-related tests, passes. Therefore this story is fully implemented and passes.
